name: AWS WAF - Security Analytics - Threat Intelligence
description: The Sumo Logic AWS WAF (web application firewall) app provides a rich source of security findings allowing you to monitor the HTTP and HTTPS requests that are forwarded to CloudFront as well as control overall access to your content. Each dashboard in this application takes a different lens on AWS WAF data, from traffic patterns to threat intelligence, allowing you to truly identify the needles in the haystack that drives critical security concerns within your AWS infrastructure.
title: AWS WAF - Security Analytics - Threat Intelligence

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/WAF  ALLOW
| parse "\"httpMethod\":\"*\"," as httpMethod,"\"httpVersion\":\"*\"," as httpVersion,"\"uri\":\"*\"," as uri, "{\"clientIp\":\"*\",\"country\":\"*\"" as clientIp,country, "\"action\":\"*\"" as action, "\"matchingNonTerminatingRules\":[*]" as matchingNonTerminatingRules, "\"rateBasedRuleList\":[*]" as rateBasedRuleList, "\"ruleGroupList\":[*]" as ruleGroupList, "\"httpSourceId\":\"*\"" as httpSourceId, "\"httpSourceName\":\"*\"" as httpSourceName, "\"terminatingRuleType\":\"*\"" as terminatingRuleType, "\"terminatingRuleId\":\"*\"" as terminatingRuleId, "\"webaclId\":\"*\"" as webaclId nodrop
| where action="ALLOW"
| count as allowed_ips by clientip
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=clientip 
| where  type="ip_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as Actor
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = clientip
| where country_name matches "{{Country_of_Interest}}"
| where clientIP matches "{{Client_IP}}"
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count
